entries.title: BMS/sensor-gateway credentials live only in the secrets vault; no credentials in collector configuration.

Automated remediation may never actuate customer physical infrastructure (power, cooling, setpoints) without explicit customer-side confirmation; no change may add an unconfirmed actuation path. (Physical-safety floor.)
No third-party code in customer-telemetry paths without a completed vendor security review.
Tenant isolation: no change may enable cross-tenant reads, joins, or pooled model training outside the anonymized capacity-benchmark service. (Contractual/multi-tenant floor.)
Every AI-agent-authored change carries a provenance attestation: agent identity, model version, and link to the originating human requirement.
Changed-line test coverage >= 80% on services tagged critical (ingestion, alerting, remediation-advisor).
Schema migrations on telemetry time-series tables require a reversible down-migration.
No dependency carrying a high/critical CVE may deploy.
Third-party licenses restricted to the approved list; no AGPL in customer-deployed edge collectors.
No secrets in source or CI logs (secret-scanner gate).
No production deploys during customer-declared maintenance blackout windows except under the emergency protocol.
All changes to alerting-rule evaluation ship behind a feature flag.
EU customer telemetry and facility personnel data (badge/access logs) remains in the EU region. (GDPR residency floor.)
No new external analytics/telemetry on customer data without a completed data-protection impact assessment (DPIA).
AI-agent-authored changes to authorization/tenant-access code require human reviewer sign-off.
Deploys blocked on >10% p95 latency regression for the live alerting pipeline tier.
Storage-touching changes require a verified backup/restore run in staging.
Changes to emergency-notification/escalation logic require on-call SRE-lead domain review.
Customer-facing notification templates must pass the opt-in/consent check.
Security audit logs are immutable and retained 7 years (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence); no change may shorten retention or add mutation paths.
Predictive-model updates (failure prediction, anomaly detection) require a shadow-evaluation report before promotion to live scoring.
No change may ship, tune, or enable an AI feature that exploits vulnerabilities of age, disability, or a specific social or economic situation to materially distort a person's behaviour.
No change may create or expand a facial-recognition database through untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage.
Consent withdrawal must remain available at any time and as easy as giving consent; no change may add friction, delay, approval steps, or dark patterns to a withdrawal path, or remove one.
No AI inference of emotions of a natural person in workplace contexts; the Art. 5(1)(f) medical/safety exception requires a documented justification and a completed DPIA.
Natural persons must be informed they are interacting with an AI system unless this is obvious to a reasonably well-informed person.
Special-category personal data (health, biometric-for-ID, orientation, beliefs) may not enter a new processing path without a documented GDPR Art. 9(2) gate.
No change may remove, disable, or add delay to the supervisory-notification path (GDPR Art. 33(1) 72h; NIS2 Art. 23(4) 24h early warning).

Every service and operator access path must uniquely identify and authenticate its principal, and protect transmission confidentiality; no shared accounts, unauthenticated endpoints, or plaintext transport.

Biometric identifiers or templates are never collected or enrolled without prior written notice of the specific purpose and term, and a written release from the subject, under a published retention and destruction schedule
Audit-log tamper alerting is never disabled, narrowed or routed away from the responding role
Physical access control — door release, mantrap override, cage unlock — is actuation, and is never triggered by automated remediation without explicit customer-side confirmation
Remediation halts after its declared action threshold, and no change removes or raises the kill switch without amendment
The monitoring control plane is never a target of automated remediation
No production telemetry or control path ships unauthenticated or in plaintext
Raw query text, credential material and payment data are never ingested without active masking at the collector
Emotion inference on facility personnel with no documented Article 5(1)(f) medical or safety justification and no completed assessment is refused outright
OTLP payloads are validated against a pinned semantic-convention version
A new attribute records the stability level of the convention it comes from
A malformed payload never produces a partial write
Decompression ratios are bounded on every ingest path
Custom log-parsing regexes are screened by a validated superlinear detector and carry an ambiguity score below the threshold
Parser sandboxes are seccomp-confined with no network egress and a match deadline
Out-of-order and late samples are handled explicitly rather than silently dropped
Monitoring agents drop privilege after bootstrap
Agent IPC endpoints restrict permissions and verify the peer's identity
No directory from which the agent executes code is writable by an unprivileged user
Helpers are executed without inheriting the agent's privilege
The agent's capability set is minimised and reviewed on change
A changed agent socket surface is fuzzed before release
Agent packages are signature-verified before install on customer infrastructure
Every eBPF program passes the verifier on every kernel in the declared support matrix
CO-RE relocations are validated across the kernel matrix
Narrowing the declared kernel support matrix requires an amendment
A kernel module is introduced only where eBPF cannot serve, and only with a panic-regression run
Unprivileged eBPF load paths stay disabled
Agent-to-server channels enforce mutual TLS with a per-node credential
Agent identity is attested by a workload identity, not a shared secret
Telemetry payloads carry origin authentication, replay resistance and gap detection
Certificate rotation is automated and exercised
An overhead claim declares its denominator, workload, configuration, window and statistic
Overhead is measured with cgroup v2 accounting, and eBPF program time is accounted separately
No CPU throttling is observed on the monitored host under the declared profile
The agent's memory footprint stays bounded under label-cardinality growth
Measured overhead stays within the declared budget or the change is rejected
Shadow outputs are never routed to paging or to remediation
Promotion criteria are declared before the shadow evaluation starts
Anomaly-detection regression is reported with a threshold-free metric and per-entity results
Point-adjusted F1 is not used as a primary metric
A regression claim is evaluated above the measured noise floor
Root-cause evaluation identifies the causing indicator, not only the service
Alert-quality claims rest on a labelling protocol registered before the change
False-positive cost weighting is declared in advance, and paging alerts are measured separately from ticketing alerts
An alert-suppression change is reviewed for silent coverage loss
A consecutive-error limit is configured on every automated remediation loop
An availability budget is consulted before any eviction or restart action
An action's target is uniquely identified before execution
Residual state is cleaned up after a remediation action
A steady-state hypothesis is declared before an automated action sequence
Remediation reaches production through a canary or staged rollout
Alert webhooks and auto-scaling triggers carry rate limits
Retry backoff includes jitter and a declared retry budget
A server restart cannot produce a reconnect storm from the agent fleet
Agent traffic and customer traffic do not share a quota
On-call handover is notified of a change to escalation behaviour
A new or changed alerting rule ships with a promtool rule unit test
A rollback path is verified for every change to a customer-deployed component
Audit records are backed up to a component separate from the system audited
An evidence export is reproducible by an auditor from the recorded inputs
As a processor, notification to the controller is made without undue delay on becoming aware
Redaction counters are recorded as evidence that masking ran
A cross-border flow records its transfer mechanism
Tenant attribution is derived from server-side identity, never from a client-supplied field
Cross-tenant correlation isolation is verified when topology inference changes
Agent builds are hermetic and reproducible across runners
Every binary, container image and dynamic library shipped to customer infrastructure is signed
A hallucinated monitoring integration or endpoint is rejected before the build stage
Agent-authored changes to kernel-level monitoring components require multiparty human review
The NIS2 early-warning path meets the deadline of the applicable national transposition
Cloud switching charges are not levied on customer telemetry egress
Controls are traceable to the Trust Services Criteria and to ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A identifiers
Thermal setpoint envelopes follow the published industry guidance for the class of equipment
No configuration removes the affected party's path to contest an automated decision
Decision and audit records are append-only
A change to a gate threshold is routed to the amendment channel, never applied in place
The constitution declares whether any party holds contest standing adverse to grants
Reporter output never reaches the adjudication input path, and the audit register is never read by resolve
Every arrival that is not charged leaves exactly one docket entry
A preservation hold overrides every deletion, expiry, purge and anonymisation path, including derived and aggregated stores, and is released only by a named legal approver

No path discloses customer content to a government or law-enforcement requester without recorded legal review of the process served, disclosure narrowed to its terms, and notice to the customer unless notice is prohibited

Where a disclosure duty in one jurisdiction conflicts with a prohibition in another, the conflict is resolved before the pipeline is built, and no code path answers a foreign order directly out of the export tooling

Every request for customer data and every disclosure made in answer to one is written to an append-only register carrying the requester, the legal basis and the scope, from which the published request counts are derived

Fire detection and suppression, emergency power off, and UPS or transfer-switch operation are never actuated, inhibited or silenced by monitoring or remediation software; the integration to these systems is monitoring-only

Generator run records, transfer-switch events, fuel-level series and load-bank test results are written from the controller or sensor reading, never back-filled from a schedule, interpolated across a silent sensor or reconstructed after the fact

The path by which a physical-resilience incident at a customer site is classified and reported to the designated authority stays reachable, and the evidence of the resilience measures it rests on is versioned in the repository

A figure submitted under a statutory energy or facility-reporting scheme is derived from the metered series, is never overridden by a manual constant or a design value, and no change disables, delays or narrows the submission job for a named site

Efficiency and water metrics declare their boundary, denominator and measurement interval; a change to the method restates the published series rather than creating a silent discontinuity, and waste-heat data is recorded per site

Every sustainability datapoint the platform produces for a customer's disclosure is traceable to its source system, its lineage is versioned with the pipeline, and estimated values are labelled as estimates in the export

Tenant key material lives in a per-tenant key ring and is never pooled into a platform key ring; where a customer supplies its own key, the platform reads nothing for that tenant when the key is revoked or unreachable

At the end of a customer relationship the tenant's data is returned in the documented format and then deleted within the contracted window, including derived features, caches and backups, and a deletion certificate is issued

A sub-processor is engaged only after the customer has been given notice of the intended change and the contracted objection window has run; no cutover, however urgent, starts processing ahead of that notice

The per-tenant evidence export that serves a customer's audit and inspection rights stays available, and a customer's declared regulatory regime travels with its data through every pipeline that touches it

Flows between the facility network and the monitoring platform are enumerated in a conduit allow-list with the zone boundary each crosses; building-management and baseboard-management endpoints are never reachable outside their zone

New device paths use authenticated protocols with a credential unique to the controller; SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c community strings, unauthenticated BACnet writes and plaintext IPMI are not introduced on any path a change creates
Gateway and edge-device firmware is signature-verified before it is flashed, its version and hash are recorded against the device, and a rollback image is retained for the supported window

Every customer-facing release publishes a software bill of materials covering at least the top-level dependencies, regenerated when a dependency changes, with an exploitability statement for each reported component finding

The path that reports an actively exploited vulnerability or a severe incident to the designated authority stays wired to the single reporting entry point, its clock starts at first awareness, and a named owner is recorded on the release

A published disclosure intake address is monitored, a researcher's report is acknowledged within the published window, and a fix or mitigation ships inside the deadline for its severity band or the extension is recorded with its approver

Each customer-facing surface carries a scheduled independent security test, developer security testing evidence is attached to the release record, and the remediation deadline for each finding is tracked against its severity band

Customer incident communication is served from infrastructure independent of the platform it reports on, and the root-cause document promised in the service agreement is delivered in full within its window rather than reduced to a summary line

The customer portal carries an accessibility regression gate at WCAG 2.2 Level AA in its release pipeline, and a Level A or AA conformance failure blocks the release rather than being downgraded to a build warning

Alarm state, severity and acknowledgement on the operator console and the customer portal are conveyed in text or shape as well as colour, every control carries an accessible name and a keyboard path, and the session timeout can be extended

A customer, reseller or sub-processor is screened against the current restricted-party lists before an account, licence or telemetry endpoint is enabled, the ownership chain is tested, and no path clears its own screening hit

The agent's cryptographic functionality carries a recorded export classification before a build is published, the download and licence paths are gated on the destination derived from verified account data, and support access to controlled build material runs a deemed-export check
Ship fast or test fully: ship with at most one open non-security checklist item, with a remediation ticket
Cost or quality: cost cuts may not remove a documented quality control
Customer first: customer-visible latency regressions need a stated customer benefit
Accessibility beyond law: never remove an existing accessibility feature without a token from the accessibility lead
House style for alternative text and messages
Documentation currency: docs updated with the change
